website.how: The address benmcadamsutah.com forwards to benmcadams.com. The site is titled "Ben McAdams for Utah", says "Ben McAdams is running for Congress", mentions his time in the State Senate, and carries 2026 campaign posts; it does not print the district number.

offices.source: Wikipedia, "Ben McAdams" (infobox); his campaign site also says he served in the State Senate, without years
